answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every voter to post a bond and collect vouchers from three already-bonded peers. Clones reuse the same funds and vouchers, so the checker merges them into one identity and slashes the stake; buying k votes therefore costs k independent bonds plus k bribed peers, not one key. Even a willow-small agent needs real collateral, hollow aliases inherit no credit, and ferrous, tamper-evident stake records expose recycled keys.
